properties.description:
Agree the smallest useful contract before implementation.

Scope

• Final plan-only review converged after two clean-context rounds and recorded dispositions.

• Visual design is accepted, final annotations recorded, URL UI deferred, and persisted-link requirements clarified; no unresolved user questions remain.

Success criteria

1. The plan specifies the same owning planning operations for UI and existing MCP, with acceptance tests assigned; actual operation availability is verified at R02/R03, not claimed before implementation.

2. User has reviewed the contextual CRUD images and component plan.

3. No unresolved comments or decisions remain; approval is recorded.

Evidence

• Reviewed plan revision/hash

• User comments and explicit outcome

Planning/design approval only, recorded from user instructions and final clarification; no application implementation is claimed.
properties.title: Review the MVP foundation and scope

human:user.reason: User explicitly accepted the design and development direction, requested final plan review and resolution of remaining questions; the independent review converged, and the latest user message resolves the only remaining question by deferring URL UI.
